text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness. Baku, could you spare a
second?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Certainly! What's up? I do need to head
over to
the teachers' office soon,
though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even better, then! Could you
demonstrate that
one breathing
exercise? The Victory V? Ready...
go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh-what?! I'm not really following, but
I've got
your back! *Inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Great! That's the Baku I know. You
sounded really
dark and gloomy a
minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But remember what we learned in the
Victory
Club? When things look bad,
just breathe and do
your Victory V!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now that you mention it! I do feel
a lot
better about my odds now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident that I can turn in a good
apology
for accidentally Bakushin
bursting through a
closed door.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Oh no... If only I'd spotted you earlier...
